name: Miko to Akemi no Jungle Adventures
original_name: ミコとアケミのジャングルアドベンチャー
source:
Miko and Akemi went on a long-awaited African trip, but their airplane crashed. Now you need to lead them out of wild jungle with dangers on every corner.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美子和明美终于踏上盼望已久的非洲之旅，不料飞机却意外坠毁。现在，你必须引导两人走出危机四伏的原始丛林。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
